name: LethAL R141 Filter Probe
brief: R141: does SetFilter on a Code[20] field accept the not-blank idiom '<>'''', and what does each planned mutant count?
description: Throwaway probe, not for production use. Measures the four counts R141's new fixture arm needs: the baseline not-blank filter, the same call with the SetFilter deleted (void-method-call), the same call with the SetRange deleted (remove-setrange), and what BC reports the filter to be. See docs/roadmap/R141.md.
